author: Tazz
body:
Hey
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CjgKtoWbk_Y
Here is my pov of highlights from the BC VS PB match. The match lasted 59:44 before the last monument was destroyed.
At 6:12 you see what we meant by the server freezing; this was a bad occurance, it was never as bad as this however it would freeze very often for numerous players.
@PureBlox, it was a great game and lots of fun. GL with your other matches!
Thanks
